title: Review the public release before it is published (one local page)
instructions: Open in your browser: ~/fw-release/build-2026-10-13/review.html (Finder: Go > Go to Folder, paste ~/fw-release/build-2026-10-13, double-click review.html). Look at the pictures (the 48 with text found come first) and read the 53 texts; tick anything that should not be public, then press Copy flagged list and paste it here. Also answer the 2 choices at the bottom of the page. Tap Done with the list, or write: nothing flagged.
